reason: I travel a lot and forget pills at home, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the part that works for me. The named lab and the batch report make me trust it more than the usual TikTok Shop stuff, and $24.99 is easy to try once.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium can be subtle and I don't want to finish 30 sachets and just feel nothing.
